errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the blue portion of the chart as a column/bar chart ('стълбова диаграма'), when it is an area chart.

errors.evidence: The description states that the orange line is located on top of the blue columns. This is misleading, as the orange line represents a different metric (percentage change) and its vertical position is not functionally dependent on the top edge of the blue area; they are two separate data series plotted in the same space.
